data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 散场后的座位
data.description: 观众席已经空了，雪菜坐在前排，把刚收好的节目单放在膝上。
data.action: sitting in a front-row seat with a program on her lap
data.lighting: 学园祭散场礼堂顶灯柔和余辉与舞台微光
data.promptProse: Sitting alone in the first row of an empty, shadowed auditorium after the crowd has dispersed, Setsuna hugs a folded school festival program against her chest, looking up at the darkened stage with a tender, bittersweet smile. Faint blue work lights illuminate floating dust motes and rows of empty red theater seats, capturing her nostalgic warmth.
data.animaCaption: Fading auditorium stage lights cast gentle golden trails across the velvet seats where Setsuna sits in quiet nostalgia.
